name: Scott Peters
subject: I demanded answers today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Peters for Congress
body:
---
| | Hey Peter, Today I stood in San Diego with business owners, labor leaders, and community advocates to demand that the Trump Administration start processing DACA renewals on time. Right now, it takes twice as long to become a citizen as it used to and frankly, the delays look intentional. They look political. And they are upending people's lives. **Nearly 9,000 DACA recipients call San Diego home. They work here, they pay taxes here, and for most of them this country is the only home they have ever known. Every day a renewal sits in a backlog is a day someone can lose their work authorization, their income, and their health coverage. Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. I’ve made my position clear.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260728-2&t=1&akid=3786%2E587540%2Eb_SOF0)
Over the last few days, I’ve made my position about the latest DNC drama crystal clear — on social media, on CNN, and in my previous emails to you, Peter:
**Ken Martin needs to resign as DNC Chair.**
Between hiding an $18M debt, mortgaging headquarters to keep the lights on, and releasing a pathetic election autopsy that completely ignored why we lost — and left the entire conclusion section blank — it’s clear that the establishment is not up to the task of winning over voters and beating Donald Trump.
When I was DNC Vice Chair, I walked away because I saw that these political insiders were trapped in a cycle of self-preservation and damage control. It became clear that people were more focused on changing what we say instead of addressing who we are or why we actually lost.
They aren't willing to do what it takes to fight MAGA extremism or restore trust with voters. Democratic candidates across the country are tainted by the national party’s failing brand — and it’s a liability for us in the midterms.
Which brings me to the absolute most important point I can make right now:
**The solution to our party’s crisis is NOT going to come from inside this DNC.**
Just look at Democrats’ total failure to raise money right now. The cash problems are so bad at the DNC that they are asking vendors to hold off on invoicing them. These fundraising challenges are not because people love what Republicans are doing, it's because they don’t know what Democrats stand for other than not being Republicans.
Unlike the DNC, the progressive movement isn’t millions of dollars in debt. We’re winning. And we’re building a real shakeup to the establishment that voters crave.
If we want a movement that actually fights for working families, stands up to Trump, and wins in 2026 and 2028, we will have to do the work ourselves.
**That’s why we built Leaders We Deserve.** We’re doing the work the party and the establishment have failed to do: investing in the next generation of bold, progressive leaders and building long-term power, all while _refusing_ corporate PAC money.
Regardless of what happens at the DNC, we’ll keep fighting to fulfill this mission because we can’t afford to lose sight of what really matters at this moment.

Thank you,
David Hogg

But after everything we’ve seen over the past year, that’s simply not realistic.

ICE is beyond repair. It should be abolished. [ If you agree, split a donation between Blue Amp Action and me now, so we can keep fighting. ](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/14416?t=11&refcode=&akid=2724%2E259176%2EhsQ-fn &amount=10 10&amounts=25,50, 100,250) But abolishing the agency alone isn’t enough. There has to be accountability for the people who broke the law.

The masked agents who broke the law while carrying out these abuses should be prosecuted. You can’t enforce the law if you think you’re above it, and we’ve seen too many ICE officers act exactly that way — refusing to identify themselves, intimidating the communities they’re supposed to serve, kidnapping, and even killing American citizens with a sense of impunity.

This isn’t just dangerous for our communities. It undermines trust in our democratic system.

The only way to rebuild that trust is to start with accountability. Then we can build the system our country actually needs: one that encourages people to come here legally, provides a clear pathway to citizenship, and enforces the law in a way that reflects American values.

body:
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked on more campaigns than I can count, and let me tell you: **I don’t rattle easily.**
But this race in New Hampshire? **It’s TIED. In a dead heat. And that should scare the hell out of every Democrat in the country.**
**[💥 Before you read another word, chip in $10 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas pull ahead right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260728_3.DpfUZ_&refcode=em20260728-3&t=1&akid=7985%2E582294%2EWex6fr)**
**[Chip in Now »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260728_3.DpfUZ_&refcode=em20260728-3&t=2&akid=7985%2E582294%2EWex6fr)**
Here’s the deal: Jeanne Shaheen is retiring. That means this seat is wide open. **And now John Sununu — yes, one of those Sununus, the long-time New Hampshire political dynasty — is running to flip it red.**
He’s got the name, he’s got the money, and he’s got the full weight of the Republican donor class behind him — from Wall Street to the far-right Super PACs. They see New Hampshire as their ticket to locking down the Senate for another decade.
And right now? **This race is neck-and-neck. It could go either way.**
Chris Pappas is our guy. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot — _CANNOT_ — do this alone.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, whatever you can spare to help Chris take the lead and hold the line in New Hampshire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260728_3.DpfUZ_&refcode=em20260728-3&t=3&akid=7985%2E582294%2EWex6fr)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260728_3.DpfUZ_&amount=5&refcode=em20260728-3&t=22&akid=7985%2E582294%2EWex6fr)**
The GOP knows if they take New Hampshire, Democrats don’t have a shot at retaking the Senate. And they’re ready to bury us in negative ads and dark money.
We’ve got to fight smarter, faster, and harder. We’ve got to help Chris Pappas build the campaign we need to win. **Let’s show these Republican bigshots that they can’t buy another Senate seat. Not on our watch.**
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260728_3.DpfUZ_&refcode=em20260728-3&t=23&akid=7985%2E582294%2EWex6fr)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. The contributor's signature designates his or her contribution to the elections described above. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.

name: Troy Jackson
subject: How we win this race and defeat Susan Collins

body:
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260728-tj.u_5QYd&amount=5&refcode=em20260728-904&t=2&akid=904%2E34582%2Ee7qpK5)
Peter,
Growing up in Allagash and spending years working 80-hour weeks in the woods to make ends meet, I know firsthand what working Mainers need from our government.
And for 30 years, Susan Collins has failed us. Time and again, she has sold us out to Donald Trump and his MAGA agenda while pretending we’re too dumb to notice. **And I’m sick of it.**
My name is Troy Jackson. I’m a proud Mainer, father, and fifth-generation logger.
**[This weekend, I officially earned the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate. Now it’s time to defeat Susan Collins and her billionaire backers. So I’m asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Small Town PAC to become a Founding Donor to my campaign right now and help us win the most important Senate race in the country.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260728-tj.u_5QYd&amount=5&refcode=em20260728-904&t=3&akid=904%2E34582%2Ee7qpK5)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260728-tj.u_5QYd&amount=5&refcode=20260728-904&t=4&akid=904%2E34582%2Ee7qpK5)**
Peter, let me tell you a bit about what this race means to me.
When I was growing up, I was a poor kid in a town full of poor kids. My family relied on food assistance at times. I distinctly remember when I was 13 years old, we didn’t have heat or running water, and I heard my mother quietly crying to herself, wishing she could do more for us.
After high school, I became a logger like my dad, and his dad, and his dad before him. When a greedy landowner tried to screw my fellow loggers and me out of fair wages, I fought back. A whole bunch of politicians, including then-first-term Senator Susan Collins, promised to listen, but they left us high and dry — and I realized that _nothing would change_ unless there were working-class voices in power.
So I ran for the Maine legislature, where I served 20 years, including six years as the President of the Maine Senate. It’s been the honor of my life to fight for working people.
I drove hours each way between the North Woods and the State Capitol, because that's what the job required. I won those elections in a district that went for Trump by 20 points, because up here, people care less about a label and more about whether you give a damn about their family.
Peter, I’m building this campaign the right way. With grassroots support from folks like you. I’m not running to impress the billionaires or the corporate class. I’m running for the mom who’s worried about how she’ll fill her gas tank this week. I’m running for the kid whose whole life will be determined by the quality of his education. I’m running to ensure every working family in Maine has the government they deserve.
**[If you believe in this fight and our movement, I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between my campaign and Small Town PAC today to help us reach our fundraising goal and take on the GOP’s millions. Even $5 makes a difference>>](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260728-tj.u_5QYd&amount=5&refcode=em20260728-904&t=5&akid=904%2E34582%2Ee7qpK5)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260728-tj.u_5QYd&amount=5&refcode=20260728-904&t=24&akid=904%2E34582%2Ee7qpK5)**
In solidarity with you always,
Troy Jackson

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end.

name: The Democratic Party
subject: You deserve the truth
body:
We owe you an explanation, Derek.
---
Derek, You deserve to know the truth about what you might have read about the DNC this week. Did you see that we took out a loan in 2025? That’s true. **Did you see that Donald Trump's pay-to-play Republican National Committee has nearly a 10-1 cash advantage over Democrats? That’s also true.** If you want to help us compete with the GOP’s massive war chest, [**we hope you’ll consider making a donation today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-eom-july-2026?amount=7&refcode=em_20260728_8284_fr&refcode2=8293_22930333_JFfehB&akid=8293%2E22930333%2EJFfehB) But we also hope that you keep reading, because, really, we do owe you an explanation. Last year, we chose to make unprecedented investments in key races, state parties, and organizing infrastructure to support Democrats running for office. We didn’t have the money to pay for it yet, but we were confident that we’d see _big_ returns at the ballot box. And that’s _exactly_ what’s been happening. Democrats have won or overperformed in 271 of 303 key elections since Trump took office, and we’re on track to see an even bigger blue wave this November. We’re still feeling confident, because we have the strongest and most passionate grassroots team behind us. When we say that **_99.7% of our donations come from grassroots donors_** chipping in a few bucks to emails like this one, we’re not kidding. Democrats like you make it possible for our legal team to take the Trump administration all the way to the Supreme Court — _and win._ Democrats like you keep the DNC running and ensure that our candidates have the tech and data infrastructure they need to win. Democrats like you, Derek, are the reason we can make investments like the ones we made last year. And please know that we don’t take it for granted, not for a second. Every $7 donation here and $15 donation there genuinely makes a difference. So if you’re worried about the state of the Democratic Party, know that we are not taking our eyes off the ball. ---
| | | This is Dr. Jasmine Clark, the Democratic Nominee for Congress in Georgia’s 13th District. I also have a PhD in microbiology. A few years ago, Republicans in Georgia tried to ban AP African American Studies.
---
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136185766/636654790/-12840034?refcode=260728_JC_afam-studies-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTMwZDI5OS1lYzhhLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j6zFrmKOyXBtYJFIYOeOOMDQKyne6nytRZ6Tpj7PwT8=)
---
They wanted politics to dictate what could and couldn't be taught in our classrooms. **I wasn't about to let that happen. So I fought back —**** _and won._** That's one of the proudest moments of my time in the Georgia legislature because it wasn't just about one class. It was about a simple principle: Students deserve an education rooted in facts, not political ideology. As a scientist and educator, I've spent my career believing that knowledge is something to be pursued, not feared. **Whether it's science, history, or public health, I believe our students deserve the truth — even when it's uncomfortable for politicians.** Yet unfortunately, the attacks haven't stopped. Across the country, we're seeing extremists target classrooms, censor books, undermine teachers, and attack higher education. Instead of preparing our kids for the future, they're focused on culture wars. I've never backed down from those fights in Georgia. **And when I get to Congress, I'll bring that same determination with me.** [**But first, we have to get through November. The same special interests and political extremists who want to silence educators and rewrite history are paying close attention to races like this one. They know I'm not afraid to challenge them. Can you help me keep fighting by making a contribution today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136185767/636654791/-12840034?refcode=260728_JC_afam-studies-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTMwZDI5OS1lYzhhLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=j6zFrmKOyXBtYJFIYOeOOMDQKyne6nytRZ6Tpj7PwT8=)

clean_body: | | | = | | | This is Dr. Jasmine Clark, the Democratic Nominee for Congress in Georgia’s 13th District. I also have a PhD in microbiology. A few years ago, Republicans in Georgia tried to ban AP African American Studies. = They wanted politics to dictate what could and couldn't be taught in our classrooms. I wasn't about to let that happen. So I fought back — and won. That's one of the proudest moments of my time in the Georgia legislature because it wasn't just about one class. It was about a simple principle: Students deserve an education rooted in facts, not political ideology. As a scientist and educator, I've spent my career believing that knowledge is something to be pursued, not feared. Whether it's science, history, or public health, I believe our students deserve the truth — even when it's uncomfortable for politicians. Yet unfortunately, the attacks haven't stopped. Across the country, we're seeing extremists target classrooms, censor books, undermine teachers, and attack higher education. Instead of preparing our kids for the future, they're focused on culture wars. I've never backed down from those fights in Georgia. And when I get to Congress, I'll bring that same determination with me. = = I've proven that standing up works. Now let's send that fight to Washington. | |
Kshama's organization, Workers Strike Back, is hosting a meeting **TOMORROW, Wednesday July 29th, at 5pm PT / 8pm ET** to get more people involved in the final days of the campaign, and to discuss what to expect on election night.
**The meeting is for members only, so**[**become a member of Workers Strike Back today**](https://us.list-manage.com/14RZrKLENda?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**to help spread Kshama's fighting strategy nationwide! Then**[**RSVP to attend the meeting on Zoom**](https://us.list-manage.com/kI_noWJiPx1?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**.**
---
| [RSVP FOR THE WORKERS STRIKE BACK MEETING](https://us.list-manage.com/qsz0n9Ozrjk?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| [RSVP FOR THE ELECTION NIGHT PARTY](https://us.list-manage.com/V0GlUasfVR4?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| | Dear Peter,
Our historic campaign to elect the first-ever revolutionary socialist to Congress is approaching a critical deadline. We have been on the ground talking to tens of thousands of people who are excited about the prospect of having Kshama in Congress, with her history of going to war and beating the billionaires and their political servants over and over again to win major victories for working people. They support our demands to tax the rich to fund free healthcare for all and create millions of affordable homes, and to shut down ICE and end all military aid to Israel and create a permanent arms embargo against the Israeli state. They are fed up with the AIPAC-backed Republican and Democratic parties, and love the fact that Kshama is an independent socialist.
**But we also know that working people are not accustomed to voting in primary elections.** The reason is that we usually do not see anyone on the ballot who is worth voting for. We are used to ballots where the only choices are Republicans and Democrats who have sold out to the billionaires and who support endless wars. **We need to let working people in Washington's ninth congressional district know that Kshama is different, that this is a campaign worth voting for, and that they need to submit their ballots as soon as possible. Many working and young people are yet to vote, and we need every Workers Strike Back member who can to join us in canvassing and getting out the vote.**
---
| | [**Sign up to phonebank, doorknock, table, and more to get out the vote for Kshama!**](https://us.list-manage.com/xFwWfsjHl6v?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
---
| | Kshama's organization, Workers Strike Back (WSB), has been a driving force in this fighting campaign. It was the first organization to endorse our campaign, right after the launch in June of 2025. Many members of Workers Strike Back around the country are regular volunteers with the campaign. **WSB is hosting a meeting of members TOMORROW, Wednesday July 29th, at 5pm PT / 8pm ET to get more people involved in the crucial final days of the campaign, and to discuss what to expect on election night.** The meeting is for members only, so [**become a member of Workers Strike Back today**](https://us.list-manage.com/ykla5ymC6rv?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**to help spread Kshama's fighting strategy nationwide** , and then [RSVP to attend the meeting on Zoom](https://us.list-manage.com/lNyzbuu1103?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)! For a relatively new organization, Workers Strike Back has an impressive track record of victories, from [defeating attacks on renters rights in Seattle](https://us.list-manage.com/1aNDbUtaPpx?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15), to [stopping over $4 billion in Washington state budget cuts](https://us.list-manage.com/b86S_MtUPYN?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15), to [defeating a proposed hyperscale data center in Illinois](https://us.list-manage.com/2OvsbjtIBwN?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15).
---
| | [**Become a member of Workers Strike Back today!**](https://us.list-manage.com/qFE9XE0H8Oc?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)
[**RSVP to attend the meeting on Zoom**](https://us.list-manage.com/oB4AbF4qhtt?e=bbdb764b3a&c2id=8b3f9b08d69d5a7a0bcc2cd67f268e15)**TOMORROW, Wednesday July 29th, at 5pm PT / 8pm ET**
---
| | Let's put everything we have into these final days of this primary election campaign. The working class globally deserves a better society and future than the one we see right now that is full of violence and exploitation and environmental disaster, driven by the billionaires and their political parties. It is possible for the working class to win, but we need leaders like Kshama who have proven that they are prepared to lead working-class movements. **As Kshama has often said, when we fight, we CAN win! And if we don't fight, we are guaranteed to lose.** So let's fight to get Kshama into the November election.
Solidarity,Justin BareCampaign ManagerKshama for Congress

name: Rose Penelope Yee
subject: The campaign is over. The work continues.
body:
Thank you for believing in this campaign. Here's where we're headed next.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/JEImxgGAues?e=8c53948e4c&c2id=06d66eac9b545d55bb613c1fdc65532c)
| | | | | |
# The Campaign is Over. The Work Continues.
---
| |
Dear Friends,

Thank you.

I deeply appreciate each and everyone of you who volunteered, donated, hosted an event, shared a post, displayed a yard sign, or simply believed in our campaign.

Although we did not advance to the general election, we stood up for something bigger than a single race. Together, we brought up issues that our elected officials have fallen short on: healthcare, economic justice, peace, accountability, and building a democracy that truly serves ordinary people. It was a privilege to have been in this journey with you.

Now it's time for the next chapter.

Last weekend, I had the privilege of attending the **California Working Families Party** Convention, where I met organizers and leaders from across the state who are building people-powered movements in their own communities. It reminded me that while every campaign is local, we are part of something much larger: a growing movement of people fighting for People, Peace, and Planet.

I was also honored to be elected once again as Chair of the Democratic Central Committee of Shasta County. I look forward to continuing the work of engaging more people in civic life and helping build a stronger culture of democratic participation here in the North State.

At the same time, I continue to believe that our democracy needs stronger institutions that give people a meaningful voice between elections.

Over the coming months, I'll be exploring the creation of the **People's Policy Council**. The vision is simple:_**** a space where community members can regularly discuss public policy, identify local priorities, develop thoughtful solutions, and help hold elected officials accountable regardless of party._

My hope is to build something that is constructive, collaborative, and rooted in the people it serves. A civic institution that can be a model for communities across the country to adapt for themselves.

If that vision resonates with you, I'd love to continue the conversation. I've created a separate interest list for those who would like to help shape the People's Policy Council from the very beginning.

[**Join the People's Policy Council Interest List.**](https://us.list-manage.com/1CjK62s476N?e=8c53948e4c&c2id=06d66eac9b545d55bb613c1fdc65532c)**

**Thank you for your encouragement, your generosity, and your friendship. Campaigns may end, but the work of building an economy that serves People, Peace, and Planet is the work of a lifetime. I hope you’ll continue that journey with me.
With gratitude and in service,**Rose Penelope Yee

** PS. If you're looking for another way to stay involved today, I encourage you to learn about and support [**Hartzell Gray's campaign for Congress** in Missouri's 4th District](https://us.list-manage.com/OIwy7v9R6An?e=8c53948e4c&c2id=06d66eac9b545d55bb613c1fdc65532c). Hartzell is part of a new generation of leaders committed to putting working people first, and campaigns like his deserve our attention and support.

body:
Recapping tonight's performance
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260728-3093)
Peter,
Fran said it loud and clear tonight. “**I am your fighter**.”
She’s coming off the debate stage after making her case in front of Wisconsin that we need to fix what’s fundamentally broken in our state. We can’t keep letting costs go up while people struggle, we can’t let the wealthy buy elections, and we can’t let Wisconsin miss it’s moment for a real progressive leader
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_202607281.QC7sUT&refcode=em20260728-3093&t=1&akid=3093%2E105371%2E3CS9mo)
_Green’s a great color._
She called for transparency and public money needing to go to public schools. She called for a vision of public safety that involves investment in communities, not just the police. She told big tech that our natural resources are not for sale.
Fran demonstrated the boldest, clearest vision of how we can make Wisconsin work for working people. She showed that We Make Better Possible, and we are so glad we got to have a debate to show the difference in a crowded field.
We have two weeks left, early vote began today, and this race will come down to the wire. One of our opponents announced today they raised over $700,000 this month thanks to the support of the ultra wealthy - we aren’t going to ask you for quite that much - but we really need your support so we can keep getting our message out across Wisconsin.
[If you’re able please contribute $10, $25, $50 or more to help us finish strong and get our message out across the state. She showed that We Make Better Possible, and we are so glad we got to have a debate to show the difference in a crowded field. We have two weeks left, early vote began today, and this race will come down to the wire. One of our opponents announced today they raised over $700,000 this month thanks to the support of the ultra wealthy - we aren’t going to ask you for quite that much - but we really need your support so we can keep getting our message out across Wisconsin. With gratitude, Becky Cooper, Campaign Manager Email us: mailto:info@francescahong.com

| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016Gj3Rw1YfMaoDgllUTFmDnLspF_10RJjSjvIUTWApi-Jd4PblMu1Yko2T35XG3aDHqQ1eM6AHHB1MrIk3ca4zwY5DGPEZnLy8xjPPP7oK3SgNVoKORZ66G_JpwqOVHx-2r1nUzSgo0XxeGYc3fSic0EYmkgz67HKwaULQffLZsEfOJerRq0N_-qFkRUhhJHnNDtzYmZgmPNLjsCR075b5K443zFu9KcWqp2SFAhKc6MXsTzo4lwt1w==&c=Z_Y3cc_cqON6nOlkWLWEWlRlbInrljmwQK9JUd8mSbN1aUREIelGow==&ch=bfuKWpqTg678goKYJUI_-ADXHKFH3fnjY9twN0e5mQ8oWdLGAj14AA==)

|
Peter,
In the span of a single week, ICE agents killed three people.
In Maine, an agent shot and killed Johan Sebastian Duran Guerrero, a 26-year-old with a valid work permit and Social Security number, as he sat in his car with his three-year-old daughter beside him. The next day in Florida, a man was struck and killed by a tractor trailer while fleeing immigration agents. Days before, in Houston, an agent shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a father of three and a small-business owner, as he drove.
There have now been at least 11 murders by ICE since Trump took office. But instead of accountability, the Trump administration is conducting a cover-up. Last week, the FBI was told it will no longer investigate violent incidents involving immigration agents. Those cases will now be investigated by Homeland Security Investigations, a branch of ICE itself.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016Gj3Rw1YfMaoDgllUTFmDnLspF_10RJjSjvIUTWApi-Jd4PblMu1Yko2T35XG3aDHqQ1eM6AHHB1MrIk3ca4zwY5DGPEZnLy8xjPPP7oK3SgNVoKORZ66G_JpwqOVHx-2r1nUzSgo0XxeGYc3fSic0EYmkgz67HKwaULQffLZsEfOJerRq0N_-qFkRUhhJHnNDtzYmZgmPNLjsCR075b5K443zFu9KcWrbefhXSTa1aIaHUaHzO_Qw==&c=Z_Y3cc_cqON6nOlkWLWEWlRlbInrljmwQK9JUd8mSbN1aUREIelGow==&ch=bfuKWpqTg678goKYJUI_-ADXHKFH3fnjY9twN0e5mQ8oWdLGAj14AA==)

This is a massive cover-up, a scandal that at any other point in American history would have ended in the impeachment and removal of a president.
And it's no surprise the Trump admin is desperate to bury the truth. The ACLU just released a report that documented how ICE is routinely trampling constitutional rights in its violent operations. And recent reporting revealed that the ICE agent behind the Maine shooting had a documented history of domestic violence, including assaulting his daughter and threatening to slit his wife's throat.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016Gj3Rw1YfMaoDgllUTFmDnLspF_10RJjSjvIUTWApi-Jd4PblMu1Yko2T35XG3aDHqQ1eM6AHHB1MrIk3ca4zwY5DGPEZnLy8xjPPP7oK3SgNVoKORZ66G_JpwqOVHx-2r1nUzSgo0XxeGYc3fSic0EYmkgz67HKwaULQffLZsEfOJerRq0N_-qFkRUhhJHnNDtzYmZgmPNLjsCR075b5K443zFu9KcWbztsoAfeumNbL9SOB4En2g==&c=Z_Y3cc_cqON6nOlkWLWEWlRlbInrljmwQK9JUd8mSbN1aUREIelGow==&ch=bfuKWpqTg678goKYJUI_-ADXHKFH3fnjY9twN0e5mQ8oWdLGAj14AA==)
---
These are the kind of people the Trump administration is handing a $50,000 signing bonus, a mask, and a gun before turning them loose on our streets.
If Democrats retake the House and Senate this November, they reclaim control of key oversight committees, and with them the power to subpoena ICE officials, compel testimony under oath, and pry loose the documents this administration is burying right now. Given what we know now about ICE, just imagine what's being hidden.
There is no doubt this is a major reason why Trump is working so hard to rig the midterms. He knows what Democrats would find, so he's trying to kill the investigations and the elections that would empower the investigators, all at once. There must be justice for the people ICE has murdered--but none of it is possible unless we make this election too big to rig.
That's where Defend Our Courts comes in. We're working to expand the firewall of state Supreme Courts on a national scale this November, and to turn out voters in the states with the House and Senate races that will decide who holds the power to investigate ICE's crimes. To do that at the scale this moment demands, we need your help right now:

| | Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who killed Goliath, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons. King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others? Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel. **This beautiful course is now available on DVD. You can reserve your copy using this secure link:** [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcuK3TAMQL_G2SXYsvNaZFHIZNWZ0gfMMji2kivqxCa273D_vmS47Qd0KR1x4KD31_lVk6Nje9M7DhTjbL2dHz7v-nH49PvwH-mGa3YuJn8-ZuDQlLwtoZ-1SXTHWenCDjWIbu0KHETb1VL0qlHFbai7pV6XXiqNHBYrQOLSNwtXbYMIsBQ0XD7eQi84VwAVrAhihb6plRZCdEzxHKxOWNERyWI03ofgHSUysfLnVrjhllKITH5hMDGYIpp8oq1u5Fy02mGFNjOY_s0MJqvvZMvPoNLeLZNTTvts9B40bQeT4-fBfCFoLhR9Pg0yOYbTx4Am0bE90Y6W8s7kiLsm91wafyQ8EpPj97Z8__Wj_JvJoImGyZFz1ao3Dgq-inr8Nr68_CzOwYYPco5i0zLFt8tXGb8X6X__ch_gTwAAAP__Zk-e4w) By taking this course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.** Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**
Happy learning,

## Washington Buries Sen. Lindsey Graham
President Trump eulogized Sen. Lindsey Graham as a "true American original" Tuesday at Washington National Cathedral, capping [a day of tributes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OtCAUBfCnwU4DVwQtKL7Gbr52S4NyVTb8mQAzxLffuLtvsN1NbnJOfufjsTy0dTYc_7VHVfa4BKzZYSmYliPpU_u8vwIm7QJWb52zMegFKIiWyhamxWjrroU3Ru2IgH2Dislx6Nkk-dicamXbyHvGpRkHJmHgK2X7Ou5iRGH0qhur7jQqYWKUTlR2YhMSBaPCcBSDmQinaGyJqfuMNpQTd3fFN6Zui75x6izlmUn_j8BMYK61dtuab8X9JzDfJ4HZ2WAyXu0Pqv1FtSW9_LPFl4vHRWBukjLPejOzkITTw2vrvovKn9Z5K_gKAAD__8giekw) that opened with a congressional tribute in the Capitol Rotunda. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky both attended. Each [met separately with Trump](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M3unCAUBfCnwR0TPhzQBYsmjbtpuuvS3IGr0CIYwDH26Rv7Cv_1SU7O-f16zS8IMaT1B2xo2pLnhGeN2BqWeS3gYavLkbBATHhuIcaQE8yCCUWZpmKcHYR4zX3nzIIoUHZouB6eko-6HzpvpOVgBz0wpx0yK8AOcuTL6N5MabW8u2DuNqbFyBkbmX4oqzQqzpTrUT3dSHqGLrRcHr9zSM3jEq_8wfKweeui8a3tlchvRExETPC294M7I2L6mWNowVYipoQN0gX-oH8xYqp_rovuR_UUVkwOKj19aEh9PirSDbGFtFbayrHtREy15XIROQVH5Hcun1xIxllXjNvPG6UqTXq2bhDi_1ntS5YfI_4FAAD__4JJiio) at the White House hours earlier, with Zelensky pressing for faster access to Patriot missile interceptors. The Netanyahu session centered on Iran and expanding the Abraham Accords. An Israeli official said the talks produced progress but [no final agreements](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2O6yAUBOCnwV2sY0z4KShu4y633RIRc4iJMET4bFDefuV9ha1H-jQzXzd38ymn8vjvd7QUqyvYj4xE2Nyj-c3vR_wu2Hwu2PeUc6rFOw5cXkBduHHBp_xxYgg2InKcB7ST0td5MkroYbNKyxXu0xTgLrQW97Ci0UqgNkLpGMWQ7KmB4mYCMKBGuUqFcgIZBMprMEwAhkS1jc-aCm0Y86e-sY1r3YdsN6LXweZ_jC-ML7338fmqB50p40sqhK14OmtnxhffKK0ZLwZmw69Ds-HVz1WHVEzAY_cp_7r0pzPelv8EAAD__290cwo). Tuesday marked five months of the war. Senators planned a test vote on the Russia sanctions bill Graham had championed before his death. subject: I need your urgent help (re: new GOP ad buy)
body:
These attempts to discredit me and our grassroots movement are desperate – but they are also working.
|

Peter, this is not good: This morning, the GOP’s top super PAC launched their very first attack ad buy against me, which means we’re officially being outspent by the Republicans.
**This super PAC is officially up on TV in North Carolina for the first time this year – spreading lies about me and our campaign – and if you care about flipping this seat and the Senate, I need your urgent help to fight back.[_Will you chip in $5 or any amount right away?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1028&amount=5&t=8&akid=2399%2E124072%2Eea-GYC)

The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and there’s a simple reason why:
If we lose in North Carolina, Democrats will lose our chance at taking back the Senate for the people.
Republicans are flooding this race with millions in dark money to crush our momentum, President Trump is taking to social media to launch unhinged tirades against me, and MAGA loyalist Stephen Miller was recently on Fox News smearing my name.
These attempts to discredit me and our grassroots movement are desperate – but they are also _working:_ **The latest poll shows my narrow lead in this race cut to about four points.**
**If folks like you chip in now and help us have our biggest fundraising day of the month, we can turn things around. If not, we risk letting our slim lead slip away.**
[**_That’s why I’m personally asking, Peter: Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today so we can respond to the GOP’s new attacks, flip North Carolina and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1028&amount=5&t=13&akid=2399%2E124072%2Eea-GYC)
Thank you so much. I’m grateful for whatever you’re able to contribute.

Roy Cooper

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

## Judge Orders ICE Shooting Witness Released
A federal judge has ordered ICE to release Jose Trinidad Rojas Pliego, a key witness to agents' fatal July 7 shooting of Houston driver Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, within 48 hours. U.S. District Judge Keith Ellison [ruled Monday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGS2zAQQ7-G6uihVrRoFSrSsLu0KTVr7kpijiY95N7J_vuMMvmDdCgweAB-fSwfGFPM20988CyvtSyZj5ZYhOtCKBg4C9d2x_CZsO0DPWvMCxgYtXEapoUwpvdiO5rvhqa-47l3t-sAMLmx22d0aO10G-zgBmTj3IQAK1s70sRjGLo4n2HGwdT3Bq72MhBhP95hxWsYRzMpa5iilHqRnYVf2Nb0Lt9cL6E8ujTvIs-mhh8KvAJ_HMclpBg-YS9fTUo-XQr8OUuBTyVgUuBPpgJv3KlvCvzKxBWT_v1FG-tSiWvTMbCWoisnxsb6iJK5NU0sGDOTxlW4amKk9Nb_eLrtpUjMmwLf1ZmeR0wpttEpa7YHxvS3tvzf2d8z_AkAAP__PPeUlQ) that holding Rojas Pliego, who has lived in the U.S. nearly 30 years with no criminal record, without an individualized hearing violates his due process rights. In [written statements released Tuesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8GOiMzEBMXLrahy7ZbosEegrXGjjyzIfn7VZ7eH7z26upenfPnttwwppjvv_EgJ6-tLJlOTiRCdQko6CkLVV7R_03I-xAeNeYFNBilJwV2CRjTexnb4FYdbN-S66frZQCwk2l3R2DHK4697Udt0VurwUx-pS0MsPmB2ug-Y3oC2_caLmM3hIC9WWHDizdG22bUFKKU2slOQi_kLb3Lk2rny9Emt4s8uBl-NTA3MJ_n2W3lBWYv_1hK_pQamD9UDczfoYqeFO-lSMx3xYJCB2VhBeqMkomZWD0xq0qJkCm01YXHGVOKbKZm1PcDY_r6l59Zezr4HwAA__9TN4Pk), Rojas Pliego and fellow passenger Daniel Tirado Pantoja say agents kept firing after the van stopped, disputing the government's account of the shooting. ICE maintains the officer fired in self-defense after Salgado Araujo rammed an agency vehicle, and [DHS hasn't responded](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHOozAQhuHTmM7IDGBw4WIbumy7JRrwAN44dmRPQnL7FXuFvxvpkV6Nvj-3-YY--Lj_xgdZ_mxpjnSWQMyUZ4eMK0WmXBZc7wHL0bpn9nEGBVqqQYKZHfrwnbvK2UU501Rkm2HsWwAz6Oqw3YodKk1qNU6PvRoNbGozWqNuWzBL5e0VUwOYplHQd3XrHDZ6gQ37VWtlRKfIeU655oOYPli28E1vyvWaHlWwB_OziPaXgEnAdJ5nfV_4c6GA6WoLmNRw3aOA6e_L7SRTdpSLzBQIC8k7feXpOVIp8kivwilKv5IsR0rs437h4aPsxotzETBV2brn6UPwRQ-iU_sDffj_Ef9sx7eFfwEAAP__bnqG0Q) to requests for comment on the order. | | **Brent Is Now at $86. Down From $102 Last Thursday. The Market Has Priced $16 of Ceasefire Hope in Five Sessions. Here Is the Gap Between What the Market Is Pricing and What the Energy Infrastructure Can Deliver.**
---
| | The cost of Brent crude oil dropped by 2.9% to almost $86 a barrel by 5:32 a.m. ET Wednesday, following reports that the US and Iran were preparing to restart shaky ceasefire talks after lethal strikes petered out last week. Brent at $86 on Wednesday represents the following trajectory since Thursday: $102 (Houthi tanker strikes peak) → $90 (Monday pause announced) → $86 (Wednesday ceasefire-talks-resuming). The $16 decline over five sessions is the market pricing two things simultaneously: the bilateral US-Iran pause holding, and the deal being negotiated centered on "fewer Hormuz restrictions." What the $86 price does not price is: Hormuz remains at well-below pre-war traffic levels; the Yanbu terminal was struck this weekend and damage is still being assessed; Kazakhstan's CPC pipeline is still suspended (80% of Kazakh exports disrupted); and the Houthis are still operating despite the US-Iran bilateral pause. All four of those supply disruptions remain intact. The market is pricing the diplomatic probability, not the physical reality. The physical reality is: the world has less oil supply than it had in February regardless of what happens at the negotiating table.
---
| | The EIA's July STEO forecast Brent at $74 for Q3. Current Brent at $86 is $12 above that forecast. Even in the most optimistic ceasefire scenario — deal signed this week, Hormuz begins partial reopening, Houthis stand down — oil experts including CNBC's own analysis note that "opening will only be partial," that infrastructure damage takes months to repair, and that the insurance premium on Hormuz transits will remain elevated long after any political agreement. The structural floor under oil, even in a full ceasefire scenario, is approximately $77–82 — not the $74 EIA forecast written before the war's second phase began. The August 11 STEO, now 13 days away, will be the first government document to price that structural floor explicitly. Every dollar between $74 and $82 that the EIA is forced to revise upward is the permanent economic legacy of 152 days of war — the price that doesn't go away when the guns go quiet.
---
